title: Welcome to Adaptive Palette.
symbols: Adaptive Palette helps you communicate with symbols: Bliss symbols, pictures, or both.
message: Choose symbols, and your message builds up here, at the top.
adapts: Adaptive Palette uses AI to adapt to you and your needs, so you can be yourself.
privacy: The AI runs on your own computer. Your messages stay with you and are never sent to the cloud.
part-words: Let's take a tour. First, Bliss gives you ways to change a word, and AI helps.
indicator: An indicator changes how a word is used. Here, it makes child plural.
indicator-result: AI works out the new word: children.
modifier: A modifier changes a word's meaning. You can add one or more, like opposite of.
modifier-result: AI works out the new idea: adults.
compose: Need a word that isn't in Bliss? Build it from symbols you know, like person, walk and dog.
compose-name: AI suggests names for it, like dog walker. Choose one, or type your own.
part-sentences: Next, turn a few symbols into exactly what you want to say.
predict: As you choose symbols, AI suggests your next word.
sentences: Make Sentences turns your symbols into full sentences, like: I'm taking Rex for a walk.
tone: Set the style of your message, like happy, polite or urgent, and the sentences change to match.
tone-result: Now it says: I'm so happy to take Rex for a walk!
about-me: How did it know your dog is called Rex? Adaptive Palette learns about you, like your family and how you like to talk. You decide what it keeps.
closing: Adaptive Palette: your symbols, your words, your way.
credits: Funded in part by a grant from IDEA, the New Frontiers in Research Fund and the Government of Canada. Developed by OCAD University and the Inclusive Design Research Centre.
